title: Governance at the Boundary: How Agent Decomposition Degrades Policy Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2608.16055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing agent benchmarks ask whether the agent finished the task. We ask whether it finished it within policy. We introduce Fiducia-bench, a benchmark for the governability of financial agents---whether they escalate when obligated, abstain when required, and leave an auditable trail---and use it to study a question no prior benchmark addresses: does decomposing an agent into components degrade its governance? It does, and the mechanism is specific. Policy-relevant facts discovered by one component are attenuated at the handoff boundary before reaching the component that must act on them. translated_title: 治理边界：代理分解如何降低政策合规性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16055v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现有的代理基准测试询问代理是否完成了任务。我们则询问它是否在政策范围内完成了任务。我们引入了Fiducia-bench，一个用于金融代理可治理性的基准测试——即它们是否在必要时升级、在要求时弃权，并留下可审计的痕迹——并用它来研究一个先前基准未涉及的问题：将代理分解为组件是否会降低其治理能力？答案是肯定的，且机制是具体的。由一个组件发现的与政策相关的事实，在传递到必须采取行动的组件之前，会在交接边界处被减弱。在一项涉及100个KYC/AML任务变体、两个模型和三种架构的626集实验中，一个32B开放权重模型在单循环基线下降解了0%的发现事实，在固定管道下降解了56%，在编排器-子代理架构下降解了85%（均在约束距离2下）。一个更强的模型（gpt-4.1-mini）在这些条件下降解了3-6%。
tldr: 本文通过Fiducia-bench基准测试首次揭示，将金融代理分解为多个组件会显著降低其政策合规性，关键在于政策相关事实在组件交接边界处被系统性衰减，且架构越复杂衰减越严重。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Fiducia-bench to reveal that decomposing financial agents into components degrades policy compliance, with policy-relevant facts systematically attenuated at handoff boundaries, worsening with architectural complexity.
